description: Delete a published short link before its TTL using the delete_token returned by publish_url.

delete_token.description: The delete_token that publish_url returned for this link.

id.description: The published link id, or the full short URL (https://a2uicatalog.ai/s/<id>) returned by publish_url.

name: unpublish_url

ok.description: True when the link was deleted.
